title: Love for God and Neighbor
sourceBasis: World English Bible — 66-book Old and New Testament Scripture text already installed in Iron Sharpener
definition: Love for God and neighbor is the biblical command that all relationships must be shaped first by devotion to God and then by faithful love toward others. True love is governed by God’s truth, holiness, mercy, and commands.
summary: Love for God and neighbor is the biblical command that all relationships must be shaped first by devotion to God and then by faithful love toward others. True love is governed by God’s truth, holiness, mercy, and commands.
christFocus: Jesus Christ perfectly loved the Father and loved sinners sacrificially. Through His life, death, and resurrection, He shows what love is and makes His people able to love God and others rightly.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture joins love for God and love for neighbor. People cannot rightly separate devotion to God from how they treat others, and they cannot define love for others apart from God.

Jesus taught that the greatest commandments are to love God with all the heart, soul, and mind, and to love one’s neighbor as oneself. These commands summarize the moral shape of life before God.

Neighbor love is practical. The parable of the Samaritan shows love moving toward need with mercy, cost, and action, not merely words or feelings.

Christian love begins with God’s love for us. Believers love because He first loved them, and that love must become visible in relationships marked by truth, mercy, justice, and service.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content:
Many people define love by emotion, approval, attraction, or tolerance without truth. Scripture defines love by God’s character and commands, so love must be both compassionate and holy.

This doctrine keeps relationships from becoming self-centered. Love is not using others to meet personal needs; it is honoring God and seeking another person’s good before Him.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Ask whether your relationships are being governed by love for God and love for neighbor. Let Scripture correct selfishness, indifference, harshness, and false love, and seek practical ways to serve others in Christ’s name.
